questions.q: What does the Lookup activity actually do?
options: Retrieves a dataset or single value from a source, for later activities to use dynamically
Copies data from a source to a sink
Deletes rows from a table
Sends an email notification
questions.explain: Unlike Copy, Lookup doesn't move data anywhere — it reads a value or dataset so a later activity can reference the result instead of using a hard-coded value.

questions.q: What changes when firstRowOnly is set to false instead of true?
options: The output becomes a value array of every matching row, with a count, instead of a single firstRow object
The Lookup activity stops working entirely
It switches from reading a table to reading a file
It automatically triggers a Copy activity
questions.explain: firstRowOnly: true (the default) returns one row under firstRow. Setting it to false returns every matching row as a value array — exactly the shape a ForEach activity expects to iterate over.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of rows a Lookup activity can return?
options: 5,000 rows
50 rows
There is no limit
1 million rows
questions.explain: Lookup returns a maximum of 5,000 rows (and 4 MB of output) — beyond that, only the first 5,000 rows come back.

questions.q: What does the Stored Procedure activity NOT support?
options: Output parameters — a procedure that needs to return a value needs Lookup or Script instead
Azure SQL Database as a target
Passing input parameters to the procedure
SQL Server as a target, with a self-hosted integration runtime
questions.explain: The Stored Procedure activity is a one-way call — it doesn't support output parameters. A procedure that needs to return data to the pipeline requires the Lookup or Script activity instead.

questions.q: What's a classic real-world pattern using the Lookup activity before a Copy activity?
options: Reading a table name dynamically from a configuration file, then using it as the Copy activity's source
Deleting the Copy activity's sink table before every run
Sending the copied data to an email address
Converting the Copy activity into a Stored Procedure activity
questions.explain: A Lookup activity can read a table name from a config file, and the Copy activity right after it references that value dynamically — so the pipeline never needs redeploying just because the target table changed.
